about: The shell's stack for shots/19-dianluo/nacre.py (reused unchanged), shot 19 round 1 (螺钿 dish). Starting values of docs/research/luodian.md section 5. Tags: [M] measured in the source, [D] secondary source or read off a figure, [A] model assumption or our choice. Isotropic aragonite (n_alpha = n_beta = n_gamma = 1.63) as in Salman et al. 2021's model, not the S2 uniaxial values.

aragonite_n_alpha.source: Salman et al. 2021 (PNAS 118 e2023623118) Methods: isotropic 1.63 in their TMM (an assumption of that model; the principal indices are 1.530/1.681/1.686 at 589 nm)

organic_n.source: Salman et al. 2021 model assumption (citing Snow et al.)

organic_nm.source: Salman et al. 2021 model (fixed); Song, Soh & Bai 2003 measured 21-31 nm in H. iris

organic_spread_nm.source: our choice, inside Song 2003's 21-31 nm range

tablet_spread_nm.source: Salman et al. 2021 SI section 4 / Fig. S4: one section of H. rufescens, tablet thickness ~Gaussian, mean ~420 nm, SD ~50 nm

sheet_um.source: about 100 aragonite/organic pairs at 420 + 25 nm (luodian.md section 5: Salman's code uses layers=201, i.e. ~100 pairs; an arithmetic result, not the dish's shell thickness). The number of pairs per piece is sheet / (d + 25 nm)

lacquer_n.source: as S2 (shots/19-dianluo/nacre.json): from SCI - SCE of polished black urushi by Fresnel, 1.53 and 1.57; cured-film n not found

grid.why: piece means 250-550 nm (pattern.py): the measured tablet thicknesses of abalone nacre run 245+-38 (H. iris blue), 293+-27 (green), 371+-36 / 499+-35 (H. varia centre / edge), 420+-50 (H. rufescens), 450-550 (H. iris) [查到, docs/research/luodian.md section 3]; a craftsman picks pieces by colour from all over the valve; b = n sin(angle to the layers' normal) inside the shell, up to 1.4 (S2's grid)
